# Peterborough Curling Club

> > Wheelchair-accessible curling club in Peterborough, Ontario, founded in 1876, offering recreational leagues, junior programs, and learn-to-curl opportunities.

The Peterborough Curling Club is one of Ontario's founding curling facilities, providing year-round programming from Thanksgiving through March. The club emphasizes accessibility and community engagement through various league formats including doubles, junior, and wheelchair curling.
